en: The postcard shows an old black-and-white image of a prominent church with a tall spire and surrounding buildings. The church is identified in the corner as 'Kyrkan i Sundsvall,' which means 'the church in Sundsvall.' The front is filled with handwritten Swedish text. The reverse side features a green Swedish stamp, old style address lines, and more handwritten address details, also in Swedish.
